description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Final Budget Position Report - Annual Report of Ministry of Finance - 2019
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the publication and availability of the Final Budget Position Report (Annual Report of the Ministry of Finance) as required by the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 3 of 2003. The content primarily deals with a statutory instrument and legal compliance requirement (Section 13 of a specific Act), making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
